dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five distinct 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible on the lateral flank, featuring a sharp gradient transition from the dark primary pelt to a high-contrast light-toned perimeter approximately 3-5 pixels wide. These perimeters define dark, low-intensity interior cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of solid, high-intensity white pixel clusters is concentrated at the anterior base of the dorsal fin and along the upper dorsal midline. These clusters appear as asymmetrical, localized points without internal gradients or lumens.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli form a scalene triangle on the mid-lateral flank, while the relative distances between the anterior-most annuli and the dorsal fin base form a fixed geometric triangle on the upper dorsal plane.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal fin exhibits an unusually elongated and narrow vertical profile, characterized by a sharp, nearly perpendicular anterior edge and a slightly irregular apical geometry.
